meta.title: SLATE grocery research: drinks at the grocers, a shelf's makers before its sizes
meta.supplements: research-groceries.json, research-groceries2.json and research-groceries3.json (same product schema). This file adds products only; it repeats no product already in those files.
meta.method: Read mechanically on 2026-10-04 from the chains' own catalogue feeds, as research-groceries3.json: the Wynshop storefront search for Price Rite (store 301), The Fresh Grocer (197), Smart & Final (371) and SuperValu (5550); Giant Tiger's Shopify catalogue, the listing tagged for Ontario; Chedraui's VTEX catalogue search. Coffee (ground, instant or beans; no pods), tea, juice (no drinks, nectars or concentrates), bottled water (unflavored), beer and wine, where the chain sells them: a Connecticut or New York grocer sells beer but no wine, and Giant Tiger in Ontario neither. Up to six of each a chain, one of each maker, the cheapest a liter or kilo first, a product whose name states no maker left out. Each at its regular shelf price, as research-groceries3.json. sought is the drink it was read for; brand is the feed's, where the name states it.
